test_kernel_density: test the tree kernel_density method with gaussian, tophat, epanechnikov, exponential, linear, cosine kernels
test_neighbor_tree_query_radius: test the tree query_radius method to find neighbors within a given distance radius
test_nn_tree_query: test the tree query method for k-nearest neighbors with euclidean, manhattan, chebyshev, minkowski, seuclidean, mahalanobis metrics
test_gaussian_kde: test the tree kernel_density method results against scipy gaussian_kde for 1D data
test_pickle: test pickling and unpickling KDTree and BallTree instances with multiple pickle protocols
